mentions.name: Koalamm
mentions.description: This memo app keeps indented lists flat instead of nesting them into parent-child hierarchies, letting users move lines around freely while maintaining a simple structure.
mentions.problem: Popular memo apps like Notion and Obsidian force nested parent-child lists, and while OneNote supports a flat structure, it is clunky to use.
mentions.source_excerpt: A memo app where indented lists stay flat instead of nesting https://koalamm.com
